tool_input.description: Locate agent definition file and list working directory

cli_result.result:
**Definition check — the sentence from my Reproducibility section, verbatim and in full:**

> Repeatability must be measured on unchanged records under the same evaluator model and definition, because even a fixed or zero sampling temperature does not guarantee identical semantic judgements.

This matches what I expect of the current instrument (it binds repeatability to the *definition* as well as the model, consistent with the #1077 two-hash rationale earlier in the same file), so I proceeded.

**Evaluation complete and validated** (`VALID output_evaluation.json: rubric20-semantic`, exit 0).

## Result: 83 / 88

| Basis | Score | Denominator |
|---|---|---|
| Fixed | 94.3% | 88 (whole rubric) |
| N/A-adjusted | 94.3% | 88 (adjusted) |

`excluded_max_points: 0`, `questions_not_applicable: 0`, excluded item ids: **none**. All four trigger conditions resolved as met, each on fields belonging to *other* questions per the anti-circular rule:

- **Human subjects** (gates Q8, Q15) — from `description`/`keywords`/`collection_mechanisms`, not from the ethics fields themselves.
- **Datasets shared** (gates Q10, Q17) — `distribution_formats`, FAIRhub page/access URL, `third_party_sharing.is_shared`.
- **Software output** (gates Q11) — `external_resources` cites `https://github.com/AI-READI`, so Q11 is scored rather than excluded.
- **Collection + shared** (gates Q12, Q13) — collection fields populated and sharing condition met.

### Points not awarded (5)
- **Q1 = 4** — 12/14 fields (85.7%); `resources` and `parent_datasets` empty.
- **Q3 = 3** — 7 keywords, one short of the band; OCT, OCTA, FLIO, wearables and environmental sensing are unkeyworded despite being most of the release.
- **Q11 = 4** — comprehensive strategies, but no preparation software is named anywhere; the .fda/.sdt→DICOM and .FIT→mHealth conversions are unreproducible from the record.
- **Q19 = 4** — lineage narrated at strategy level; no `was_derived_from`, no errata, and the declared RO-Crate isn't used to carry the entity–activity–agent graph.

### Semantic analysis
26 consistency checks passed, 3 failed, 8 warnings. The arithmetic independently reconciles: collection file counts sum to nine short of `total_file_count` (matching the nine root metadata files), collection bytes land within 419,614 bytes of `total_size_bytes`, and every demographic stratification sums to 2,280 both within the cohort and across splits. Identifiers validate — three well-formed NIH grant numbers, an ORCID passing the MOD 11-2 checksum, a consistently used DOI prefix.

The three failures: `confidentiality_level: restricted` is the record's own substitution contradicting the sole sourced value and sits beside `confidential_elements_present: false`; the de-identification method is under-determined across three conflicting sources; `is_sample: false` contradicts the non-probability recruitment described in the same object. Each is disclosed by the record itself, which is why Q9 was not reduced — the disclosure preserves the field's usability — but the de-identification ambiguity is the one place where an unresolved conflict genuinely impairs a reuser's risk assessment.
